Bug_Title: Eq: equals() method defined that doesn’t override equals(Object) (EQ_OTHER_NO_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines an equals()
method, that doesn't override the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class.  Instead, it
inherits an equals(Object) method from a superclass.
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object equals(Object) boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The BuggyClass defines an equals() method that does not override the equals(Object) method defined in the base java.lang.Object class. Instead, it defines a boolean equals(BuggyClass) method. The class should define a boolean equals(Object) method.
Trigger_Explanation: The assertNotEquals() method is used to compare two objects for equality using the equals() method. Since the BuggyClass does not override the equals(Object) method, the assertNotEquals() method fails, triggering the bug.
